title: Edge SDK Instrumentation: latency surface probe & lightweight tracing heuristics
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Problem: We currently lack early, low-overhead latency signals from Edge SDKs (browser and edge workers) before requests reach the serving runtime. This causes slow detection of regressions (cold starts, DNS/connect stalls, client-side queueing) and delays SLO alerting.

Goal: Implement a lightweight 'latency surface probe' in our Edge SDKs that emits minimal tracing markers and aggregated latency metrics to the observability pipeline (no full-span payload by default). Provide a set of heuristics for sampling and fallback propagation so we can capture high-fidelity traces for a small fraction of requests while keeping SDK overhead < 1ms p95 and bandwidth small.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement server-side correlation dashboards or full trace storage; those are follow-ups (see dependencies). It also does not change existing server sampling policies except where needed to correlate probes.
acceptance_criteria: Edge JS and Edge WASM SDKs instrument outgoing requests with a 3-field probe header (probe-id, probe-ts, probe-sample) and emit a small metric event to the pipeline within 10ms of request start.
Default SDK overhead measured in lab: additional CPU < 1% for common bundles; p95 added latency < 1ms on representative devices (desktop and mobile emulation).
Probe sampling defaults: deterministic sticky 0.5% by client id + adaptive burst sampling that can increase up to 5% for error spikes. Sampling config fetched from Console feature flag.
Traces can be joined end-to-end when probe-sample=true by matching probe-id and runtime span id; implementation verified with an integration test that exercises cross-process correlation.
Telemetry and logs do not include PII; probe payload contains only opaque IDs and timestamps. Security review completed and signed off.
tasks: Design probe header format and protobuf-free wire encoding (one ASCII token per header) - deliverable: spec doc link
Implement header injection + local metric emission in sdk-js edge runtime and sdk-wasm shim
Add sampling configuration endpoint in Console flags service and SDK fetch + cache logic
Add e2e integration test in infra/e2e that runs against runtime staging and verifies correlation
Create lightweight pipeline parser to accept probe events and emit derived metrics (edge.request.latency_edge, edge.request.probe_rate)
Coordinate with runtime team to add correlation hook for probe-id -> main trace when probe-sample=true
comments: 2026-02-28 - Aisha Raman: Created ticket after incident-2026-02-24 where client-side DNS stalls led to a silent 2s increase in end-to-end p95; need earlier signal surface. Initial spec attached.

2026-03-02 - Luca Morales: Spike prototype implemented in sdk-js. Verified header injection and local metric emission. Observed ~0.6ms p95 overhead on macbook local lab. Pushed prototype branch and added e2e test scaffold.
2026-03-04 - Priyanka Desai (Security): Quick review - probe header format okay but ensure no stable identifiers that can be PII; request adding explicit 'no-pii' checklist to docs.

2026-03-06 - Luca Morales: Updated sampling to deterministic client hash + adaptive burst. Added Console flag to experiment with 2% default sampling. Open question: should we allow per-customer opt-out? (cc: PM)
2026-03-08 - Marco Chen (Runtime): Reviewed correlation hook; suggested recording runtime span id into probe join table for efficient lookup rather than scanning logs. Adjusted infra PR accordingly.
2026-03-10 - Elena Park (PM): Approved rollout plan; prioritize behind feature flag, gradual ramp to 1% across org, monitor cost dashboard and alert if ingestion cost delta > 15%.
2026-03-10 - Luca Morales: Marking In Progress. Next: finalize proto-free header encoding and land SDK PRs behind flag.
rollout_plan: 1) Canary: feature flag on internal dev org (1% sampling) for 48h
2) Ramp: increase to 5% for internal + small set of beta customers over 7 days if no alert
3) Monitor: ingestion cost, probe join success rate, false positives in correlation; rollback on >15% ingestion cost or >2% drop in traffic success rate
4) Full: flip default to 0.5% public when stable and document in SDK release notes
notes: Trade-offs: we keep probe payload minimal to avoid payload bloat and privacy concerns. This loses full span context for non-sampled requests but enables early detection of client-side regressions. Will follow up with a separate ticket to add enriched traces for sampled probes only.
